brief:
Eight foreign ministers have condemned statements and plans by Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz and National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir for the mass expulsion of Palestinians from Gaza, the Middle East Eye reported. The joint rebuke from multiple countries underscores mounting diplomatic pressure over displacement proposals emanating from senior Israeli government officials.

The international condemnation reflects widening concern among foreign governments about policy discussions centered on Gaza's Palestinian population. Katz and Ben Gvir have outlined frameworks for relocating Palestinians, triggering alarm among allied nations. The scale and timing of the foreign ministers' coordinated response signal the gravity with which the international community views the displacement proposals.
